Mrs. Fisher: To catch a brown trout, especially this big… {{wi}}I might have underestimated you a little.
You: Is it really such a big deal?
Mrs. Fisher: They are highly intelligent fish, very hard to catch. 
Mrs. Fisher: In some cultures, to this day they are considered as spirits or magical creatures.
Mrs. Fisher: There are many legends and myths about them in europe. They were so liked that settlers brought these trout with them.
You: Do you know any of these legends?
Mrs. Fisher: There’s the legend of Icelandic Lodsilungur. It’s a demonic, crimson, fur-covered trout that if eaten by a man, would impregnate him.
You: What? That’s crazy.
Mrs. Fisher: If you ever catch a fur-covered trout, you can give it to me. {{wi}}Unless you want to have your scrotum cut open when it’s time to deliver the baby.
You: If I catch it, I will gladly give it to you…
